messages.text: i orderd a bitfortun bs2 a while ago and want to know if i can get another one with the same connector so i can use the miner again

Hi Adam, happy to sort that out. Just so I send you the right thing: is it the power supply on your BS-2 that's stopped working, or the DC cable between the supply and the miner? And does the plug into the miner look like a yellow XT60 connector, or a round barrel jack?

Once I know which part it is, I can tell you exactly what fits.
like another meanwell power supply because i believe the one i have is dead
Used route to tech
I've handed this to our technical specialist, who will pick it up here.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)
Used route to tech
Passing your screenshot straight to our tech specialist now.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

I'm back on the order side, Adam. Thanks for the screenshot.

Hal's checks confirm the fault is on the miner, not the MeanWell, so a new power supply wouldn't fix it. Your BS-2 from order Shop···· has been validated as defective and the return is with the team for approval now. They'll confirm it by email shortly, and once it's approved I'll sort the return and what goes back to you from here.

Nothing to send back yet, so please hold onto the unit and the box.
okay

Thanks, Adam. You'll get the confirmation by email as soon as it's approved, and I'll pick it up here with the return details and the options for you.

One quick thing while I have you: your B30 on Shop···· is still on for November 7. Anything else you want me to check in the meantime?
no thanks
Before you go, one thing I'm curious about: you flashed Harlo OS onto the BS-2 yourself rather than waiting on us. What made you reach for that firmware in particular?
i have dealt with computer issues before where faulty firmwares have bircked machines you sold me the bs2 so i downloaded your firmware

Makes sense, and it was the right instinct. Harlo OS is our own build, so running it is no problem at all, and swapping it actually helped: the fault survived the change, which is how we knew it wasn't firmware.

One last thing, if you don't mind: where did you find the Harlo OS download, on harlolabs.com or somewhere else? Helps us know what people are actually using to get there.
harlo labs

Good, that's the right source. Thanks, Adam.

That's everything from me for now. Hold onto the BS-2 and its box, and watch your email for the return confirmation. I'll pick it up here with the next steps as soon as it's approved.
